text: 2026年7月15日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见利比亚央行行长纳吉·伊萨·贝尔卡西姆。双方就当前经济金融形势、中利经济金融合作等议题交换了意见。
text_en: On July 15, 2026, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with Central Bank of Libya Governor Naji Mohamed Issa Belkasem. The two sides exchanged views on current economic and financial conditions and China-Libya economic and financial cooperation.
